primary_task: Build a macOS app that embeds a Zoom meeting (SDK auth, then join or start a meeting with default or custom UI) using the Zoom Meeting SDK for macOS.

requirements.name: macos
requirements.evidence: Zoom Meeting SDK for macOS native apps. ... Use this skill when building macOS apps with embedded Zoom meeting capabilities.
requirements.basis: "lacks": "Windows or macOS, and their GUI toolchains (Xcode, Visual Studio, PowerShell on Windows)"

requirements.name: xcodebuild
requirements.evidence: building macOS apps with embedded Zoom meeting capabilities (a native macOS app is built with the Xcode toolchain)

requirements.name: zoom-meeting-sdk-credentials
requirements.evidence: PKCE + SDK auth, host start/join flows
requirements.basis: "lacks": "accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)"

requirements.name: developers.zoom.us / marketplacefront.zoom.us
requirements.basis: "lacks": "network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list: only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt archives, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused"

notes: Took the literal reading that the task is building (and running) a macOS app that joins/starts a Zoom meeting: this needs macOS with Xcode, Zoom SDK credentials and reachability of Zoom, all lacking. Under the other reading (only write Swift/Objective-C source code and guidance without compiling or running), the work is text and local files and would be ACHIEVABLE, with the Zoom docs hosts unreachable but optional (bundled macos.md etc. status unknown).
